{{Event Infobox
| Name  = The Joust

}}
{{E|The Joust}} is a shrine [[Event]] found in [[Act 2]]. This event can only be encountered with more than 50 [[Gold]].

== Options ==
{{Frame|Murderer}} {{TS|gold||Bet 50 Gold}} - {{TS|positive||70%: win 100 Gold.}}

{{Frame|Owner}} {{TS|gold||Bet 50 Gold}} - {{TS|positive||30%: win 250 Gold.}}

There is no option to avoid betting.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
As you make your way through the large buildings you come across a long narrow bridge and spot knights on either side, facing one another. <br>
You approach... <br>
{{TS||shake|"HALT!"}} <br>

A knight forcefully gestures you to stop with its giant lance.
</div><br><br>

{{Frame|Continue}}

<div style="font-style:italic">
"Today is the day I must settle the score with the {{TS|negative||murderer}} of my beloved pet, {{TS|gold||Noodles.}} Until then, you may not pass. <br>

Fellow witness, why don't you {{TS|blue||bet}} on who you think will emerge victorious?"
</div>

{{Frame|Murderer}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"I can't believe you're betting against {{TS|gold||Noodles!"}} <br>

Furious, he clamps down his helmet and rushes towards his nemesis.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Owner}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"Give me strength, {{TS|gold||Noodles!"}} <br>

Clamping down his helmet, the knight charges forward.
</div></blockquote>

<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
{{TS|gold|shake|* CRASH!!!* }} {{TS|negative|shake|* KLAAAANG!* }} <br>

{{TS|green|shake|* POW!* }}
</div></blockquote>

<blockquote>
'''Depending on who loses the joust:''' <i>The owner died. / The nemesis was slain.</i>
<br>
<br>

'''When losing the bet:'''
<div style="font-style:italic">You {{TS|negative||lost}} the bet, but at least you weren't gouged by a lance.</div>

'''When winning the bet:'''
<div style="font-style:italic">You {{TS|green||win}} the bet. Unsure what to think, you grab your winnings and leave.</div>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Notes ==
* If the player possesses {{R|Ectoplasm}}, this event is a mandatory loss of 50 [[Gold]]. There is no option to leave the event without betting, and any potential winnings cannot be gained.
* The player may consider using the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Expected_value expected value] (EV) of each option to determine who they want to bet on.
** The EV of betting on the Murderer is a net increase of 20 [[Gold]] (a 70% chance to receive 100 [[Gold]] is an expected 70 [[Gold]], minus the 50 [[Gold]] that was bet. <code>0.7 x 100 - 50 = 20</code>)
** The EV of betting on the Owner is a net increase of 25 [[Gold]] (a 30% chance to receive 250 [[Gold]] is an expected 75 [[Gold]], minus the 50 [[Gold]] that was bet. <code>0.3 x 250 - 50 = 25</code>)
** It may be more beneficial to ignore the EV and instead consider whether the relatively safe 50 extra [[Gold]] by betting on the Murderer is more useful to the player's current run compared to risking the bet on the Owner and likely losing their 50 [[Gold]] for the more unlikely net gain of 200 [[Gold]].
